meta.name: Touch Your Heart 720p
meta.description:
Hoping to make a comeback after a bad scandal, an actress agrees to research a new role by taking a job as a secretary for a prickly attorney.

Rated TV-14 · Ended · First aired 6 Feb 2019 · South Korea · Language: Korean · 60 min
Studio: Studio Dragon, Mega Monster, Content Zium · Network: tvN

Complete series. On your server: S1 16/16

On your server — Audio: Hindi, Korean (from file names)

videos.title: Yun Seo Goes to a Law Firm
videos.overview: After a scandal, an actress is offered a comeback role playing an attorney -- on one condition: She must first work at a law firm for three months.

videos.title: Se Won Comes to Seoul
videos.overview: At a party with her co-workers, Oh Yun-seo unwisely drowns her growing frustrations toward her boss. Yoo Yeo-reum runs into an old flame at work.

videos.title: Yun Seo's First Case
videos.overview: Yun-seo's emotional side proves helpful in a pro bono case involving a high school girl charged with defrauding her classmates.

videos.title: Studying Together
videos.overview: Yun-seo is jealous of another woman's ability to make her boss smile. Kwon Jung-rok learns his new stalking case has similarities to Yun-seo's past.

videos.title: Murder or Self-defense
videos.overview: After Jung-rok is chosen to represent Im Yun-hui against charges of murdering her husband, he and Yun-seo take a long drive to talk to her in person.

videos.title: Jung Rok and Yun Seo Investigate the Case
videos.overview: A malfunctioning elevator creates a romantic moment. Jung-rok and Yun-seo's search for evidence at a crime scene takes an unexpected turn.

videos.title: Jung Rok's Confession
videos.overview: Jung-rok's lack of dating experience leads him to Kim Se-won for advice. The stress of Yeo-reum's job takes a toll. Yun-seo runs into an old rival.

videos.title: Always Law Firm Holds a Workshop
videos.overview: Yun-seo learns a shocking fact about Jung-rok's past. A co-worker comes to Dan Mun-hui's rescue. The Always Law Firm staff go on an overnight getaway.

videos.title: A Special Date
videos.overview: Yang Eun-ji gets a police call about her daughter. Yun-seo and Jung-rok discover delightful new sides of each other, but a threat to their bliss lurks.

videos.title: A Mysterious Man
videos.overview: Mun-hui tries to resist falling in love. Yun-seo notices a man following her and confronts him. A member of Jung-rok's family seeks his legal help.

videos.title: Gang Joon Approaches Yun Seo
videos.overview: Yun-seo tells Jung-rok the truth behind her scandal, and stands up to her stalker. Mun-hui undergoes a makeover in honor of her crush's birthday.

videos.title: Yun Seo Will Act Again
videos.overview: Se-won learns how Jeong Ji-ho and Lee Kang-jun are linked. Mun-hui gets an invitation from her crush. Yun-seo and Jung-rok's romance is discovered.

videos.title: Jung Rok's New Case
videos.overview: Yun-seo returns to the busy life of a working actress. Mun-hui and Choe Yun-hyeok try contract dating. The Im Yun-hui case comes back to haunt Jung-rok.

videos.title: Jung Rok's Resignation
videos.overview: Tensions between Jung-rok and Yeon Jun-gyu boil over. Yun-seo's manager confesses to her. Lee Du-seop makes a breakthrough in the Im Yun-hui case.

videos.title: Jung Rok Gets Jealous
videos.overview: Yun-hyeok sees Mun-hui enjoying his ukulele -- with another man. Jung-rok frets about a kissing scene that Yun-seo will soon be filming.

videos.title: Yun Seo Makes a Comeback
videos.overview: Yun-seo makes the most of her time with Jung-rok before a monthlong overseas shoot. Yun-hyeok worries about Mun-hui's history of fickleness.
